title: Cosmic Skull Pond
description: A large, vibrantly painted human skull rests at the edge of a reflective pond filled with green lily pads and white water lilies. The skull features a mechanical eye and is surrounded by cosmic splashes of color, while the background shows a swirling galaxy, floating orbs, bare trees, and silhouetted figures with raised arms.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic painting of a large colorful human skull with a mechanical eye resting beside a reflective pond containing lily pads and white water lilies. The skull is covered in vibrant paint splashes. In the background are bare spooky trees, silhouetted human figures with arms raised, and a massive swirling colorful galaxy in a starry sky with floating orbs.
